enchantment.simple_tweaks.bloodlust.desc: Increases damage based on the attacker's missing health. Higher levels improve the bonus.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.crit.desc: Grants a chance to perform a critical hit even when not jumping. Higher levels increase the chance.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.crit_damage.de: Increases the damage of critical hits. Higher levels provide more bonus.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.double_crit.de: When you score a critical hit, has a chance to deal extra damage. Higher levels increase the chance and damage.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.execute.desc: Deals bonus damage proportional to the target's missing health. Higher levels increase the percentage.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.flight.desc: Allows the wearer to fly, but consumes hunger and durability over time. Higher levels reduce consumption.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.healer.desc: Converts damage dealt into healing for the target, canceling the damage and restoring health.
Heals the attacker for a portion of damage dealt, with overflow turning into absorption. Higher levels improve healing.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.infinite_power: Grants flight, invincibility, instant mining, infinite food and durability, laser attack, multiplied loot, soul-bound items, and an infinite storage bag.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.item_fixer.des: Slowly repairs the item over time. Conflicts with Mending.
Every attack has a chance to trigger an extra strike.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.void_protectio: When falling into the void, teleports you to y=256 and consumes one level of the enchantment.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.effect_bonus.d: Increases damage based on the number of active potion effects on the target. Higher levels improve the multiplier.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.immortal.desc: Grants a chance to completely negate incoming damage after accumulating hits. Higher levels increase the chance and negate more consecutive hits.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.saturation.des: Slowly restores hunger and saturation over time. Higher levels restore faster and more per trigger.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.acid_attack.de: Damages the target's held weapon on hit. Higher levels deal more durability damage.
Damages a random piece of the target's armor on hit. Higher levels deal more durability damage.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.assassin.desc: Instantly executes targets whose health is below a threshold after the hit. The threshold scales with level.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.damage_limiter: Reduces incoming hits to a percentage of your max health. Damage above a higher threshold pierces through. Higher levels increase both the reduction and the pierce threshold.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.aoe_attack.des: On hit, if other attackable enemies are near the target, the damage is split among all of them. The total damage pool is the original hit multiplied by the level, capped at 100% per enemy. Higher levels cover larger groups and keep more damage on each target.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.charged_strike: Each hit stores a portion of its damage. Your next hit releases the stored damage as bonus. Released damage is never stored again. Higher levels store more per hit.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.death_protecti: When taking fatal damage, consumes one level of the enchantment to negate the hit and grants absorption equal to the original level x 20. Higher levels grant more absorption and allow more triggers before the enchantment is used up.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.motion_bonus.d: Increases damage based on how fast you are moving relative to the target. Standing still gives no bonus; sprinting into an enemy maximizes it. Higher levels increase the maximum bonus.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.regeneration.d: Slowly regenerates health over time. Higher levels restore more per interval.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.combo.desc: Reduces the target's invulnerability window after each hit, allowing follow-up strikes to land sooner. Higher levels shorten the window further.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.swift_sneak.de: Increases your movement speed while sneaking. Higher levels make sneaking faster.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.celestial_bles: Drains life on hit and converts overflow healing into a holy shield. The shield absorbs damage and can be consumed to restore health, hunger, and durability. Attacks deal bonus true damage and shred the target's max health, while holy projectiles seek out nearby enemies.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.true_damage.de: A portion of your damage becomes true damage, bypassing the target's armor. Higher levels convert more of your damage.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.fire_master.de: Increases damage based on the target's remaining burn time. Attacks extend the target's burning duration and grant you Fire Resistance. Higher levels burn longer and hit harder.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.damage_reducti: Reduce the percentage of damage you take
enchantment.simple_tweaks.extra_armor.de: Provides extra armor point and armor toughness
enchantment.simple_tweaks.experience_ste: Add your experience base on your damage
enchantment.simple_tweaks.reforge.desc: Disappears immediately upon being applied, resetting the item's prior work penalty. Used to clear the "Too Expensive" penalty from heavily worked items.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.soul_bound.des: This item stays with you through death and returns to your inventory upon respawn.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.momentum.desc: Increases mining speed the longer you continuously mine the same block, up to +100% * lvl.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.tunneling.desc: Breaking a block also destroys adjacent blocks of the same type. Level I affects blocks above and below, Level II expands to a cross shape, Level III covers a 3x3 plane. Sneaking disables the effect.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.kill_aura.desc: While holding this weapon, automatically attack the nearest enemy nearby. Each attack consumes one durability. Higher levels increase range and reduce cooldown.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.prismatic_bles: Grants +5% to all attributes (health, attack damage, attack speed, movement speed, armor and armor toughness) per level.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.grievous_wound: Reduces the target's healing received by 20% per level for 1+0.25 * lvl seconds. At level V the target cannot heal at all. Stacks from multiple hits refresh the duration but do not add up.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.hunters_mark.d: Arrow hits mark the target for 10 seconds. The next damage of any type dealt to the marked target is increased by 20% per level, then the mark is consumed. Re-applying refreshes the duration and keeps the highest level.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.multishot.desc: Fires one additional arrow per level in a horizontal spread. Each arrow consumes one piece of ammunition. Arrows from Multishot do not reset the target's invulnerability window, allowing every arrow in the volley to land.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.tracking_arrow: Arrows gently curve towards the nearest enemy within 2+1×level blocks. Higher levels increase both the tracking range and the turning speed. Arrows stop tracking once they hit a block or pass through a wall.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.piercing_arrow: Arrows pierce through additional enemies equal to the enchantment level. Arrows still stick into blocks and can be picked up normally.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.starfall.desc: Arrows mark the target and call down falling stars. Each star chases the target and explodes on impact, dealing area damage to nearby enemies. Higher levels summon more stars, with larger radius and higher damage.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.echo_shot.desc: Arrow hits echo on the target after a short delay, dealing bonus damage. Higher levels echo for more damage and shorter delay.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.echo_shield.de: Each hit you take is partially mitigated. The mitigated portion is stored in an Echo Buffer. When the buffer meets or exceeds an incoming hit, that hit is fully negated and the entire buffer is reflected back to the attacker. The buffer is cleared on death.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.auto_smelt.des: Blocks drop their furnace-smelted result directly when mined. Conflicts with Silk Touch. Works with Fortune.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.delayed_recove: A portion of damage taken is returned to you as healing over the next few seconds. Death cancels all pending recovery.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.heavenly_punis: Grants a large bonus to final damage dealt. The struck target is weakened against you, briefly frozen in place, and its attack speed is crushed. Calls down a bolt of divine lightning on every hit. Higher levels increase damage, weaken enemies further, and extend the effect.
Consecutive hits on the same target build up a combo. Each stack adds 2%% x level bonus damage, up to a maximum of 20%% x level. Taking any damage or switching targets resets the combo. The combo also expires after 5 seconds without attacking.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.resilience.des: Reduces incoming damage the lower your health drops. No bonus at full health; with all four armor pieces at level III and health down to 10%%, the reduction reaches 84%%. Higher levels increase the reduction.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.gravity_strike: Increases damage based on how far you have fallen. The higher you drop from, the harder you hit, up to a cap. No bonus from a flat jump. Releasing the strike mid-air keeps the momentum until you land.
Taking repeated damage of the same type builds up to 6 stacks of damage reduction. Each stack reduces incoming damage by 0.9% per level; switching damage type or going 5 seconds without being hit resets the stacks.

enchantment.simple_tweaks.fast_bow.desc: Reduces bow draw time. Higher levels draw faster.
